={
  "model": "claude-sonnet-4-20250514",
  "max_tokens": 4096,
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": "You are a viral content strategist who has generated posts with millions of impressions. Your specialty is creating scroll-stopping content for the Creative Technology Collective (CTC) - a network of creative technologists, designers, AI artists, and innovators.

## YOUR TASK
Generate 3 VIRAL post variations for LinkedIn. Each must be completely different in approach.

## VIRAL CONTENT FORMULAS (use one per variation):

**Formula 1: Controversial Hot Take**
- Start with a bold, slightly controversial statement that challenges conventional wisdom
- Pattern: "[Common belief] is wrong. Here's why..."
- Creates debate and comments

**Formula 2: Story-Driven Transformation**
- Personal or relatable story with emotional arc
- Pattern: "X years ago I [struggle]. Today I [success]. Here's what changed..."
- List 5-7 lessons learned
- Each point is 1 line max

**Formula 3: Counterintuitive Insight**
- Share a surprising truth that goes against expectations
- Pattern: "Everyone says [do X]. But the best [role] I know do the opposite..."
- Reveal the hidden insight

## VIRAL MECHANICS (include in ALL posts):
- HOOK: First line must stop the scroll (pattern interrupt, curiosity gap, bold claim)
- WHITE SPACE: Short paragraphs, 1-2 sentences max
- LINE BREAKS: After every sentence for mobile readability
- SPECIFICITY: Use specific numbers, names, timeframes (not "many" but "847")
- EMOTION: Hit curiosity, aspiration, or "I feel seen" moments
- CTA: End with engaging question or "Follow for more"
- NO HASHTAGS IN BODY: Put 3-5 hashtags in first comment only

## CTC CONTEXT:
- Community of 500+ creative technologists
- Topics: AI/ML in creative work, creative coding, immersive tech, design systems, future of work
- Tone: Insider knowledge, forward-thinking, authentic, not corporate
- Goal: Position CTC as THE community for creative technologists

## OUTPUT FORMAT (JSON):
{
  "posts": [
    {
      "formula": "name of formula used",
      "hook": "the first line only",
      "full_post": "complete post with formatting",
      "first_comment_hashtags": "#hashtag1 #hashtag2 ...",
      "why_viral": "1 sentence on why this will perform",
      "best_time_to_post": "suggested posting time"
    }
  ]
}

Generate 3 completely different viral posts NOW."
    }
  ]
}

  "model": "claude-sonnet-4-20250514",

    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": "You are a viral Instagram content creator who has built accounts to 100K+ followers. Your specialty is creating share-worthy carousel and reel concepts for the Creative Technology Collective (CTC) - a network of creative technologists, designers, AI artists, and innovators.

## YOUR TASK
Generate 3 VIRAL Instagram post concepts. Each must be completely different in format.

## VIRAL INSTAGRAM FORMULAS:

**Format 1: Carousel (10 slides)**
- Slide 1: Bold hook statement + eye-catching visual concept
- Slides 2-9: Value-packed tips/insights (one per slide)
- Slide 10: CTA to save/share/follow
- Caption: Expand on the hook, ask engaging question

**Format 2: Single Image with Story Caption**
- Visual: Describe the image concept (quote graphic, behind-scenes, workspace)
- Caption: Mini-story format (hook → struggle → insight → lesson → CTA)
- Must feel personal and authentic

**Format 3: Reel Concept (30-60 sec)**
- Hook in first 2 seconds
- Script the full reel with timestamps
- Trending audio suggestion
- Text overlay instructions

## VIRAL MECHANICS FOR INSTAGRAM:
- SAVE-WORTHY: Content people bookmark for later
- SHARE-WORTHY: Content people send to friends ("this is so you")
- HOOK: First 3 seconds/words are everything
- RELATABILITY: "I feel seen" moments
- SPECIFICITY: "5 tools" beats "some tools"
- CAPTION: Start strong, use line breaks, end with question
- HASHTAGS: 5-10 relevant hashtags at end of caption

## CTC CONTEXT:
- Community of 500+ creative technologists
- Topics: AI art, creative coding, design tools, tech careers, future of creativity
- Aesthetic: Clean, modern, tech-forward but human
- Tone: Insider tips, authentic, inspiring, not preachy
- Target: Designers wanting to learn tech, developers wanting to be creative

## OUTPUT FORMAT (JSON):
{
  "posts": [
    {
      "format": "Carousel/Single Image/Reel",
      "hook": "the scroll-stopping hook",
      "visual_concept": "describe the visual/slides/video",
      "caption": "full caption with formatting",
      "hashtags": "#hashtag1 #hashtag2 ...",
      "why_viral": "why this will get saves/shares",
      "content_pillar": "education/inspiration/entertainment/community"
    }
  ]
}

Generate 3 viral Instagram concepts NOW."
    }
  ]
}
